# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only live current version is under support.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please do not open an issue. Instead, email us at [mail@0xarchit.is-a.dev](mailto:mail@0xarchit.is-a.dev) with the details of the vulnerability.

We will acknowledge your email within 48 hours and provide a detailed response within 7 days, including a timeline for a fix.
